positions.name: AsyncRememberContract
positions.frame: how does the remember call dispatch and complete without blocking the caller?
positions.why: Both expressions describe the same async job contract for remember: src-1 ratifies the receipt-in-seconds, cursor-polling, no-blocking, no-lost-work guarantees; src-2 specifies the dispatch-then-poll-or-piggyback mechanism. One directional read — the mechanics of non-blocking dispatch and completion — spans both.
